scripts.backend:status: powershell -Command "$port8000 = netstat -an | findstr ':8000' | findstr 'LISTENING'; if ($port8000) { Write-Host '✅ Backend is running on port 8000' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ Backend is not running' -ForegroundColor Red }"
scripts.backend:test: powershell -Command "try { $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://192.168.0.4:8000/' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host '✅ Backend is healthy' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host '❌ Backend is not responding' -ForegroundColor Red }"
scripts.blockchain:proof: npm run blockchain:verify && echo 'Blockchain proof generated successfully!'
